verdict.rationale: Ramp's travel page shows policy status on every booking option, so employees know before booking whether a trip complies, with no digging through policy PDFs or waiting for rejections. It also auto-adjusts per diem by location and duration and rebooks hotels when prices drop. Booking travel is surfaced in the CLI and as a 'travel' resource with trips:write scope, confirming in-platform booking. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of flight booking (only hotels and generic trips are named), detail on how out-of-policy bookings are blocked or routed for approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
